name: Achiri alpha access gate — ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST + TelegramDB tier wiring
goal: Two blocking issues for Apr 25 alpha: (1) handleAchiri hardcodes tier='free' — resolve actual tier from TelegramDB (free→free, growth→tnd_basic, premium→tnd_premium). (2) BETA_MODE=true blocks all non-owner users from /achiri — add ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST env (comma-separated chatIds) so operator can whitelist alpha invitees without code changes.
rationale: Apr 25 alpha requires non-owner users to access Achiri. Without whitelist, only OWNER_CHAT_ID can use /achiri. Without tier wiring, paid TelegramDB subscribers always get free Achiri (wrong model, daily limit). Both fixes are 1-2 line changes per file.
swarm: NOT USED — surgical edits, 2 files. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — tier lookup from TelegramDB + ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST access gate
tasks.description: In handleAchiri(): (1) Load TelegramDB.get(chatId) to get user's subscription tier. Map: free→free, growth→tnd_basic, premium→tnd_premium. Pass mapped tier in POST /chat body. (2) Read ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST env (comma-separated chatIds). If message comes in and user is NOT owner AND NOT in whitelist AND ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY=true, send waitlist message. Default: allow all (ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY not set = open beta mode).

tasks.title: .env.example — add ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST and ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY
tasks.description: Add ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST=chatId1,chatId2 and ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY=false to .env.example under Achiri HTTP Bridge section.
